data.one_liner: Secure hash functions, checksums, MACs, KDFs, and RNG optimized for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure-Dart library for cryptographic hash functions, checksum generators, message authentication codes, key derivation functions, and random/UUID generation. It supports one-shot operations and streaming inputs across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need secure hashes, checksums, or key derivation algorithms in pure Dart.
You want cross-platform support including Flutter, VM, and Web.
avoid_when: You are handling passwords without using a proper KDF like Argon2, scrypt, or bcrypt.
You require constant-time execution guarantees that pure Dart environments cannot provide.
strengths: Runs on every platform with no native code or FFI dependencies.
Comprehensive collection of algorithms including block hashes, MACs, password KDFs, and OTP generators.
Supports both one-shot and streaming computation.
weaknesses: Certain algorithms like XXHash64, XXH3, and XXH128 are not supported on the web platform.
Pure-Dart execution cannot guarantee constant-time operation against advanced timing side-channels.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard package maintained by the Dart team for basic hashing like SHA and MD5.
